mapper.select: SELECT PROG_CODE ,PROG_NAME ,REG_ID ,TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DATE FROM CRM_PROGRAM_MGT ORDER BY PROG_NAME

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.* , ROWNUM RNUM FROM CRM_MENU_MGT A START WITH MENU_CODE = '0000' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_CODE = P_MENU_CODE ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.MENU_CODE != '0000' ORDER BY MENU_DEPTH, P_MENU_CODE, ORD_NUM

SELECT IN_TB.MENU_CODE ,IN_TB.MENU_NM || ' (' || MENU_DEPTH || 'depth)' AS MENU_NM FROM ( SELECT A.* , ROWNUM RNUM FROM CRM_MENU_MGT A START WITH MENU_CODE = '0000' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_CODE = P_MENU_CODE ) IN_TB, CRM_ROLE_MENU RM WHERE IN_TB.MENU_CODE != '0000' AND RM.ROLE_CODE=#{role_code} AND RM.MENU_CODE = IN_TB.MENU_CODE ORDER BY MENU_DEPTH, P_MENU_CODE, ORD_NUM

SELECT IN_TB.MENU_CODE ,IN_TB.MENU_NM || ' (' || MENU_DEPTH || 'depth)' AS MENU_NM FROM ( SELECT A.* , ROWNUM RNUM FROM CRM_MENU_MGT A START WITH MENU_CODE = '0000' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_CODE = P_MENU_CODE ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.MENU_CODE != '0000' ORDER BY MENU_DEPTH, P_MENU_CODE, ORD_NUM

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.* , ROWNUM RNUM FROM CRM_MENU_MGT A START WITH MENU_CODE = '0000' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_CODE = P_MENU_CODE ) IN_TB, CRM_ROLE_MENU RM WHERE 1=1 AND RM.ROLE_CODE= #{roleCode} AND RM.MENU_CODE = IN_TB.MENU_CODE AND IN_TB.MENU_CODE NOT IN (${inQueryStr}) ORDER BY MENU_DEPTH, P_MENU_CODE, ORD_NUM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CRM_ROLE_MENU (ROLE_CODE,MENU_CODE,REG_ID) SELECT #{roleCode} AS ROLE_CODE ,IN_TB.MENU_CODE AS MENU_CODE ,#{regId} FROM ( SELECT MENU_CODE FROM CRM_MENU_MGT WHERE MENU_CODE IN (${inQueryStr},'0000') MINUS SELECT MENU_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_MENU WHERE ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} ) IN_TB
mapper.select: SELECT PM.PROG_CODE ,PM.PROG_NAME ,PM.REG_DATE ,PM.REG_ID ,PM.UPD_DATE ,PM.UPD_ID FROM CRM_ROLE_PROG RP, CRM_PROGRAM_MGT PM WHERE 1=1 AND RP.PROG_CODE = PM.PROG_CODE AND RP.ROLE_CODE = #{role_code} ORDER BY PM.PROG_NAME

SELECT PM.PROG_CODE ,PM.PROG_NAME ,PM.REG_DATE ,PM.REG_ID ,PM.UPD_DATE ,PM.UPD_ID FROM CRM_PROGRAM_MGT PM WHERE 1=1 AND PM.PROG_CODE NOT IN (SELECT PROG_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_PROG WHERE ROLE_CODE = #{role_code}) ORDER BY PM.PROG_NAME
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CRM_ROLE_PROG WHERE 1=1 AND ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND PROG_CODE IN ( SELECT PROG_CODE FROM CRM_PROGRAM_MGT WHERE PROG_CODE NOT IN (${inQueryStr}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CRM_ROLE_PROG (ROLE_CODE, PROG_CODE) SELECT #{roleCode} AS ROLE_CODE, PROG_CODE FROM CRM_PROGRAM_MGT WHERE PROG_CODE IN (${inQueryStr}) AND PROG_CODE NOT IN (SELECT PROG_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_PROG WHERE ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode})
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_NO ,'[' || EMP_GRADE_NAME || '][' || DEPT_NM || ']' || EMP_NM AS EMP_NM FROM ( SELECT EM.EMP_NO ,EM.EMP_GRADE ,EM.EMP_NM ,EM.DEPT_CD ,EM.MOBILE_NO ,EM.E_MAIL ,EM.RETIRE_DATE ,EM.REG_DATE ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'COMMON' AND P_CODE = 'CD04' AND CODE = EM.EMP_GRADE) EMP_GRADE_NAME ,NVL((SELECT DEPT_NM FROM KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE AA.DEPT_CD = EM.DEPT_CD AND END_YMD = '99991231'),'무소속') DEPT_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT EM ,CRM_ROLE_USER RU WHERE EM.EMP_NO = RU.EMP_NO AND EM.EMP_NO <> 'ERP' AND RU.ROLE_CODE = #{role_code} ) ORDER BY EMP_NM

SELECT EMP_NO ,'[' || EMP_GRADE_NAME || '][' || DEPT_NM || ']' || EMP_NM AS EMP_NM FROM ( SELECT EM.EMP_NO ,EM.EMP_GRADE ,EM.EMP_NM ,EM.DEPT_CD ,EM.MOBILE_NO ,EM.E_MAIL ,EM.RETIRE_DATE ,EM.REG_DATE ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'COMMON' AND P_CODE = 'CD04' AND CODE = EM.EMP_GRADE) EMP_GRADE_NAME ,NVL((SELECT DEPT_NM FROM KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE AA.DEPT_CD = EM.DEPT_CD AND END_YMD = '99991231'),'무소속') DEPT_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT EM WHERE EM.EMP_NO NOT IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_ROLE_USER WHERE ROLE_CODE = #{role_code}) AND EM.EMP_NO <> 'ERP' ) ORDER BY EMP_NM
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CRM_ROLE_USER WHERE 1=1 AND ROLE_CODE= #{roleCode} AND EMP_NO IN ( SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO NOT IN (${inQueryStr}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CRM_ROLE_USER(ROLE_CODE,EMP_NO,REG_ID) SELECT #{roleCode} AS ROLE_CODE, EMP_NO, #{regId} AS REG_ID FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO in (${inQueryStr}) AND EMP_NO NOT IN (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_ROLE_USER WHERE ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CRM_ROLE_MENU WHERE ROLE_CODE NOT IN (SELECT ROLE_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_MGT)
DELETE FROM CRM_ROLE_PROG WHERE ROLE_CODE NOT IN (SELECT ROLE_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_MGT)
DELETE FROM CRM_ROLE_USER WHERE ROLE_CODE NOT IN (SELECT ROLE_CODE FROM CRM_ROLE_MGT)
